description: SLA hollowing settings producer mutants validated by ordinary geometry assertions.

mutants.description: Replace the registered minimum wall-thickness input with its default. At thickness 10 mm on the 20x20x10 mm box, the expected absent interior distinguishes the producer read from the 3 mm fallback.
mutants.expected_oracle: The upper thickness endpoint yields an empty public interior while the 1 mm endpoint yields a positive interior.

mutants.description: Replace the registered quality input with its default. The smooth-sphere endpoint rows compare public interior mesh sampling density and radial approximation.
mutants.expected_oracle: Quality 1 produces more public interior vertices than quality 0, with each endpoint inside its voxel-derived radial RMS error bound.

mutants.description: Replace the registered closing-distance input with zero. On the 20x20x10 mm box, thickness 1 mm plus closing distance 10 mm requests an inward level-set surface beyond the 5 mm inradius.
mutants.expected_oracle: Closing distance 0 retains the positive public interior; closing distance 10 leaves no interior shell.
